name: pin-net-name
assumes: the name of a net no label or power symbol names, taken from one of its pins (pin 3 of U1, named SDA when named)
units: whether the symbol has more than one unit (U1A, U1B)
unconnected: a lone pin, a no-connect pin, or a net with a no-connect flag
every saved export in test/fixtures/kicad (KiCad 10.0.0 and 10.0.5) puts the unit letter only beside a pin name
